passage.label: Two factions believers fight make settlement between two; one oppresses other fight against oppresses returns ordinance Allah; returns make settlement justice act justly Allah loves just; believers brothers make settlement between brothers fear Allah receive mercy; let not people ridicule people perhaps better; nor women ridicule women perhaps better; do not insult one another do not call offensive nicknames; wretched name disobedience after faith; whoever not repent wrongdoers; avoid much negative assumption some assumption sin; do not spy backbite each other; would one like eat flesh brother dead detest; fear Allah Accepting repentance Merciful; mankind created male female made peoples tribes know one another; most noble sight Allah most righteous Knowing Acquainted

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ ٱقۡتَتَلُواْ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتۡ إِحۡدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّتِي تَبۡغِي حَتَّىٰ تَفِيٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمۡرِ ٱللَّهِۚ فَإِن فَآءَتۡ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَهُمَا بِٱلۡعَدۡلِ وَأَقۡسِطُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُقۡسِطِينَ
إِنَّمَا ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِخۡوَةٞ فَأَصۡلِحُواْ بَيۡنَ أَخَوَيۡكُمۡۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٞ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَلَا نِسَآءٞ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهُنَّۖ وَلَا تَلۡمِزُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَلَا تَنَابَزُواْ بِٱلۡأَلۡقَٰبِۖ بِئۡسَ ٱلِٱسۡمُ ٱلۡفُسُوقُ بَعۡدَ ٱلۡإِيمَٰنِۚ وَمَن لَّمۡ يَتُبۡ فَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱجۡتَنِبُواْ كَثِيرٗا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعۡضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثۡمٞۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُواْ وَلَا يَغۡتَب بَّعۡضُكُم بَعۡضًاۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمۡ أَن يَأۡكُلَ لَحۡمَ أَخِيهِ مَيۡتٗا فَكَرِهۡتُمُوهُۚ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٞ رَّحِيمٞ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٖ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلۡنَٰكُمۡ شُعُوبٗا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ أَكۡرَمَكُمۡ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتۡقَىٰكُمۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٞ

mainSubject.label: Inter-believer conflict resolution: settlement between fighting factions, fighting the oppressor until return to Allah's ordinance, then just settlement since Allah loves the just; brotherhood declared with mutual settlement urged alongside taqwa for mercy; ridicule prohibited between peoples and between women since the ridiculed may be superior; mutual insult and offensive nicknames forbidden, naming disobedience after faith as wretched and non-repenters as wrongdoers; excessive negative assumption warned against since some is sin; spying and backbiting prohibited with the dead-brother-flesh analogy producing revulsion; taqwa urged under the Repentance-Acceptor and Merciful; humanity addressed as created from male and female into peoples and tribes for mutual recognition, nobility defined exclusively by righteousness under the Knowing Acquainted

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the bounty-and-favour framing (8) before the inter-believer conflict rules open (9); P2 ends with the universal nobility-by-righteousness declaration (13) before the bedouin iman-submission distinction begins (14); P3 runs from that distinction through the true-believer definition, the favour reversal and the closing unseen-knowledge affirmation (14-18).
